title: Step 1: Random Forest Classifier - From Template to Implementation in R

cues.en: Instructor: Hello and welcome to this R tutorial.
cues.zh: 你好，歡迎來到這堂 R 教學。

cues.en: We are finally getting to the final round of our classification adventure in our machine learning journey because today we're making the very last classifier, the random forest classifier.
cues.zh: 機器學習旅程中的分類冒險，終於到了最後一回合，因為今天要建立最後的分類器：隨機森林分類器。

cues.en: So let's start with the basics.
cues.zh: 先從基本步驟開始。

cues.en: We'll go to our machine learning A-Z folder to set the right folder as working directory.
cues.zh: 進入 Machine Learning A-Z 資料夾，把正確資料夾設為工作目錄。

cues.en: So this right folder is in part 3 classification, and here it is.
cues.zh: 正確資料夾在 Part 3 Classification，在這裡。

cues.en: Section 20, random forest classification, that's the right folder.
cues.zh: Section 20 Random Forest Classification，就是這個。

cues.en: And as I was telling you, we are reaching the end of part three classification because the next section will be dedicated to evaluating classification models performance
cues.zh: 就像剛才說的，我們到了第三部分分類的結尾，因為下一節專門討論評估分類模型效能，

cues.en: in order to improve the models.
cues.zh: 以改善模型。

cues.en: And therefore this is our last classifier.
cues.zh: 因此這是最後的分類器。

cues.en: So let's go to this folder.
cues.zh: 進入資料夾。

cues.en: That's the folder we wanna set as working directory.
cues.zh: 這就是要設為工作目錄的資料夾。

cues.en: Make sure that you have the Social_Network_Ads.csv file and if that's the case, click on this More button here and then set as working directory.
cues.zh: 確認有 Social_Network_Ads.csv 檔，若有，點這裡的 More，再選 Set as Working Directory。

cues.en: All good here.
cues.zh: 一切正常。

cues.en: And now let's go to our classification template to build a random forest classifier with the best efficiency.
cues.zh: 現在進入分類範本，以最高效率建立隨機森林分類器。

cues.en: So we'll just take everything from here to the bottom, copy and then we'll paste it here.
cues.zh: 直接把這裡到最下方全部複製，再貼到這裡。

cues.en: All right, so I'll just give a quick reminder about what this template is doing.
cues.zh: 好，快速提醒這個範本做什麼。

cues.en: So the first step is to import the data set.
cues.zh: 第一步是匯入資料集。

cues.en: Then we encode here the target feature as factor because we are just doing this to specify to the class that our last column purchased is a categorical variable with factor levels zero and one.
cues.zh: 接著把目標特徵編碼成因子，只是為了告訴類別，最後一欄 Purchased 是具有 0 與 1 因子層級的類別型變數。

cues.en: So we don't need to do it for all the classifiers but we do need to do it for some like the Naive Bayes classifier as we saw.
cues.zh: 不是所有分類器都需要，但有些需要，例如看過的樸素貝氏分類器。

cues.en: So it's good to keep this code section in the template.
cues.zh: 所以保留這段在範本中很好。

cues.en: Then we split the data set into the training set and the test set.
cues.zh: 接著把資料集分成訓練集與測試集。

cues.en: And then in the last section of the pre-processing phase, we apply feature scaling to the data.
cues.zh: 前處理階段最後一部分，對資料套用特徵縮放。

cues.en: And we are only doing this because at the end of this template, we make this very cool graph for both the training set result and the test set results that will plot the prediction regions
cues.zh: 只因為範本結尾要替訓練集與測試集畫這個很棒的圖，呈現預測區域

cues.en: and the prediction boundary.
cues.zh: 與預測邊界。

cues.en: Okay, so right now we need to change a few things in this template.
cues.zh: 好，現在要修改範本幾個地方。

cues.en: First, let's not forget to change the title of the plot.
cues.zh: 首先別忘了改圖表標題。

cues.en: Here we'll replace classifier by random forest classification.
cues.zh: 把 classifier 換成 Random Forest Classification。

cues.en: We'll copy this because we'll do the same in the test set results.
cues.zh: 複製，因為測試集結果也一樣要改。

cues.en: Here it is. Perfect.
cues.zh: 在這裡，很好。

cues.en: Okay, and now what we only need to do is to create our classifier here and then we'll be ready.
cues.zh: 好，現在只需要建立分類器，就準備好了。

cues.en: So I'll just paste the same thing here.
cues.zh: 這裡也貼相同內容。

cues.en: Random forest classification to the training set.
cues.zh: 把隨機森林分類模型擬合到訓練集。

cues.en: And now let's create our classifier.
cues.zh: 現在建立分類器。

cues.en: All right, let's do this.
cues.zh: 好，來做。

cues.en: So it's very simple.
cues.zh: 很簡單。

cues.en: We're gonna use a library that is called random forest.
cues.zh: 使用叫做 randomForest 的函式庫。

cues.en: So let's do this.
cues.zh: 來做。

cues.en: Let's first install the package with the command, install.packages.
cues.zh: 先用 install.packages 命令安裝套件。

cues.en: So that's for those of you who are using this package for the first time.
cues.zh: 這是給第一次用這個套件的人。

cues.en: Then you won't have it installed on your packages list here.
cues.zh: 你的套件清單中還不會有。

cues.en: As you can see, mine should be already here because I used it several times.
cues.zh: 我的應該已經在這裡，因為用過幾次。

cues.en: Yes, there it is. Random forest.
cues.zh: 是的，在這裡，randomForest。

cues.en: So if it's not the case for you then you need to install the package here.
cues.zh: 如果你沒有，就要在這裡安裝套件。

cues.en: And so in this install.packages function, you just need to input the name of the library in quotes.
cues.zh: 在 install.packages 函式中，只要用引號輸入函式庫名稱。

cues.en: So it's random forest.
cues.zh: 也就是 randomForest。

cues.en: Be careful with the capital F here and not capital R here.
cues.zh: 注意 F 是大寫，R 不是大寫。

cues.en: All right, so that's what you need to input anyway.
cues.zh: 好，總之就輸入這個。

cues.en: That will install the package.
cues.zh: 會安裝套件。

cues.en: I won't do it because I already have mine installed.
cues.zh: 我不執行，因為已經安裝。

cues.en: But what you just need to do is to select this and press Command or Control + Enter to execute.
cues.zh: 你只要選取這段，按 Command 或 Control + Enter 執行。

cues.en: And this will install the package without any issues.
cues.zh: 就能順利安裝套件。

cues.en: All right, so here I'll just press Command + Shift + C to make it as a comment.
cues.zh: 好，這裡按 Command + Shift + C 設為註解。

cues.en: But then what I need to do is to add the command here, library, and then input the name of the random forest library because as you can see here, it's not selected.
cues.zh: 接著要加入 library 命令，再輸入 randomForest 函式庫名稱，因為可以看到這裡還沒勾選。

cues.en: So I need to add this library random forest command to select it automatically, especially, if I want to make some automated R scripts in the future.
cues.zh: 因此要加 library(randomForest)，自動載入它，尤其未來想做自動執行的 R 指令碼時。

cues.en: So that's a thing to do that's very practical.
cues.zh: 這樣做很實用。

cues.en: And now we're all good.
cues.zh: 現在都好了。

cues.en: Let's create our classifier.
cues.zh: 建立分類器。

cues.en: Okay, so as usual, we'll start by creating the variable classifier.
cues.zh: 好，一樣先建立 classifier 變數。

cues.en: That will be our random forest classifier itself.
cues.zh: 它就是隨機森林分類器本身。

cues.en: And now we will use the random forest function to build our classifier.
cues.zh: 使用 randomForest 函式建立分類器。

cues.en: So here, I'll just take the function, random forest.
cues.zh: 這裡選 randomForest 函式。

cues.en: And now let's see what arguments we need to input.
cues.zh: 現在看看要輸入哪些引數。

cues.en: So we'll just go here and press F1 to get some info about this function.
cues.zh: 到這裡按 F1，取得函式資訊。

cues.en: So here we need to click here, and here are some info about the random forest library and function.
cues.zh: 這裡需要點這個，這就是 randomForest 函式庫與函式的資訊。

cues.en: So let's look at the arguments which are what we're interested in.
cues.zh: 看看我們關心的引數。

cues.en: Okay, so the first argument is data.
cues.zh: 好，第一個引數是 data。

cues.en: We won't need it as you can see, it's an optional data frame.
cues.zh: 不需要，這裡說是可選資料框。

cues.en: So it's not an argument that we need to build a random forest classifier.
cues.zh: 所以建立隨機森林分類器不需要這個引數。

cues.en: Same for subset and NA.action.
cues.zh: subset 與 na.action 也一樣。

cues.en: We actually don't need the three first parameters to build a random forest classifier.
cues.zh: 其實建立隨機森林分類器不需要前三個參數。

cues.en: However, we of course need the X and Y arguments here which as you can guess, will be the matrix of features and the dependent variable vector.
cues.zh: 不過當然需要這裡的 x 與 y，你應該猜得出，是特徵矩陣與應變數向量。

cues.en: Indeed, as you can see X is a data frame or matrix of predictors.
cues.zh: 這裡確實寫 x 是預測變數的資料框或矩陣。

cues.en: So that's pretty clear. X is our matrix of features.
cues.zh: 很清楚，x 就是特徵矩陣。

cues.en: Our matrix of predictors which are independent variables age and estimated salary.
cues.zh: 也就是預測變數矩陣，自變數 Age 與 EstimatedSalary。

cues.en: And then Y is set to be a response vector.
cues.zh: 接著 y 說是回應向量。

cues.en: So of course, Y is the dependent variable vector that is the purchased column.
cues.zh: 當然就是應變數向量，也就是 Purchased 欄。

cues.en: Okay, perfect.
cues.zh: 好，很好。

cues.en: And then the last argument that we will need to build our random forest classifier is, of course, the number of trees we want to have in the forest.
cues.zh: 最後需要的引數，當然是希望森林裡有幾棵樹。

cues.en: And this number of trees is given by this entry argument here, which as you can see is the number of trees to grow.
cues.zh: 樹木數由這裡的 ntree 引數指定，可以看到，是要生長的樹木數量。

cues.en: So, to grow is a nice way of telling that the trees will learn from the dataset how to make the predictions.
cues.zh: 「生長」這個說法很好，表示樹會從資料集學習如何預測。

cues.en: And basically, this argument is the number of trees.
cues.zh: 基本上，這個引數就是樹木數量。

cues.en: So remember in the Python tutorial, we chose 10 trees.
cues.zh: 記得 Python 教學選了十棵樹。

cues.en: Well, let's do the same here. Let's pick entry equals 10.
cues.zh: 這裡也一樣，選 ntree = 10。

cues.en: And that is actually everything we need to build our random forest classifier.
cues.zh: 這其實就是建立隨機森林分類器需要的一切。

cues.en: Okay, so let's do this. Let's input the arguments.
cues.zh: 好，來輸入引數。

cues.en: Let's go back to R. And here we are.
cues.zh: 回到 R，在這裡。
